notes.title: Price Slashed !!
notes.content: Hey there folks!! This is Naz, the developer of "Chaos Uproar". The price of "Chaos Uproar" has been [b]reduced for the first time[/b] as a gift for the upcoming "Birthday" event of my studio "J.S. Gaming". Price has been slashed to 60% of its original price for our followers to enjoy the game...!!! PLAY CRAZY....!!!
